name: Shishir Sharma Upadhyay
tagline: I test web and mobile apps: manual, API, backend and a bit of automation. I also build full-stack apps, so I usually have a good guess where the bug is hiding.
summary: I can follow a defect from the screen, through the API, down to the data. That comes from manual, automation, API and backend testing (Selenium, TestNG, Postman, JMeter, Burp Suite) plus working knowledge of the MERN stack.
about: I am a Software QA Engineer in Lalitpur, Nepal. Day to day I test web and mobile apps: functional, regression, smoke, UI/UX and backend testing across multiple modules. I work with developers and business analysts in Agile/Scrum teams.

Outside work I build full-stack apps with React, Next.js, Node.js, Express and MongoDB. Building the software I test makes me ask better questions about requirements, validation, error handling and data integrity.

focus.title: Writing the tests
focus.text: Scenarios, test cases and test data written from business and functional requirements. Positive, negative and edge cases, regression selection, and defect reports someone else can reproduce.

focus.title: Poking at APIs
focus.text: REST testing in Postman: headers, authorization, status codes, response bodies, scripts and request chaining. SQL queries to check what actually landed in the database.

focus.title: Automating the repeats
focus.text: Selenium with Java, Maven and TestNG. Cypress with TypeScript for registration workflows: page objects, dynamic test data, API-assisted flows and Mochawesome reports with screenshots and video.

experience.title: QA Associate
points: Manual testing of web and mobile applications: functional, regression, smoke, UI/UX and backend testing across multiple modules.
Designed and executed detailed test cases, test scenarios and test data based on business and functional requirements.
API testing with Postman and backend data validation with SQL queries to confirm data integrity and accurate system behaviour.
Identified, documented, tracked and retested defects, collaborating closely with developers and business analysts in Agile/Scrum environments.
Tested critical workflows such as authentication, Forgot Password with OTP verification, enrollment, billing, payment processing and policy management.
Hands-on with automation and testing tools including Selenium, TestNG, Apache Maven, Burp Suite and Apache JMeter.
